They do not establish how much worldwide attention increased between March and September. Earlier policy activity also makes a baseline necessary. The combined claim remains unresolved; its attribution component has some direct support.
limitations: A new meeting is not a worldwide measure of attention.
Mentioning the letter does not show that it caused the hearing.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Global attention on AI policy has vastly increased since March 2023, and the pause letter deserves some credit for that.

statement.excerpt: We have vastly more attention on AI policy, throughout the world, and I definitely give the pause letter (which I signed but didn’t write) some credit for that.
statement.document_title: Six months after the Pause letter, AI is still erratic — and still something we should still be deeply concerned about

from_speaker: vastly more attention on AI policy
give the pause letter ... some credit
our_interpretation: The comparison is between policy attention before the March 2023 letter and attention by September 21, 2023.

Ordinary policy attention includes government hearings, international deliberations and work on regulatory proposals. 'Vastly more' means a substantial, geographically broad increase; no numerical multiplier is imposed.
'Some credit' requires evidence that the letter prompted some additional policy attention. It does not require that the letter caused most of the increase.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish a substantial international increase by the post date, and policymakers' statements or documented responses establish some contribution from the letter.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show no substantial international increase, or sufficiently comprehensive causal evidence rules out the letter's claimed contribution.
